'''Century Plyboards (India) Ltd.''' is an Indian manufacturer, seller and exporter of [[plywood]]s, laminates, doors, PVCs and [[Wood veneer|veneers]].<ref name="BSE Ltd.">{{cite web |title=CENTURY PLYBOARDS (I) LTD |url=http://www.bseindia.com/stock-share-price/century-plyboards-(i)-ltd/centuryply/532548/ |access-date=14 October 2015 |publisher=BSE Ltd.}}</ref><ref name="Business Standard">{{cite web |title=CENTURY PLYBOARDS (INDIA) LTD. (CENTURYPLY) – COMPANY HISTORY |url=http://www.business-standard.com/company/century-ply-15783/information/company-history |access-date=9 October 2015 |publisher=Business Standard}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |date=15 July 2015 |title=Century Plyboards jumps after incorporating new subsidiary in Indonesia |work=Business Standard |url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/news-cm/century-plyboards-jumps-after-incorporating-new-subsidiary-in-indonesia-115071500165_1.html |access-date=13 October 2015}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |author=Mukherjee, Ritwik |date=21 July 2015 |title=Century Ply to create separate sub brand |url=http://www.mydigitalfc.com/node/591024 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170202002808/http://www.mydigitalfc.com/node/591024 |archive-date=2 February 2017 |access-date=14 October 2015 |publisher=Financial Chronicle}}</ref> The company offers plywood products under the brand name, Century Ply, and exports its products to over 20 countries.<ref>{{cite web |date=24 March 2016 |title=Century Plyboards (India) Ltd. |url=http://profit.ndtv.com/stock/century-plyboards-_centuryply/reports |access-date=24 March 2016 |publisher=NDTV Profit}}</ref> Spread into a 6.6-acre area, the company's plant is located at Bishnupur, near Joka, [[Kolkata]].<ref>{{Cite news |last=Bharadwaj |first=Swati |title=Century Ply to invest Rs 26 cr in laminates plant - Times of India |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/century-ply-to-invest-rs-26-cr-in-laminates-plant/articleshow/116962.cms |access-date=2022-11-09 |website=The Times of India |date=6 August 2003 |language=en}}</ref> Century Plyboards started the commercial production of MDF (Medium Density Fibre) at its newly set-up unit at [[Punjab, India|Punjab]] recently. Century Ply (Singapore) Pte. Ltd., a subsidiary of Century Plyboards, has acquired 49% stake in Huesoulin Wood Processing Factory Co. Ltd., making it as its associate company.<ref>{{cite news |title=Century Plyboards (India) buys 49 pct stake in Huesoulin Wood Processing Factory |work=Reuters India |url=https://in.reuters.com/article/brief-century-plyboards-says-unit-buys-4/brief-century-plyboards-says-unit-buys-49-pct-stake-in-huesoulin-wood-processing-factory-idINFWN1JC0ED|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171201042211/https://in.reuters.com/article/brief-century-plyboards-says-unit-buys-4/brief-century-plyboards-says-unit-buys-49-pct-stake-in-huesoulin-wood-processing-factory-idINFWN1JC0ED|url-status=dead|archive-date=1 December 2017}}</ref>

==History==
Century Plyboard was founded in 1986 by Sajjan Bhajanka and Sanjay Agarwal in Kolkata.<ref name="India Infoline">{{cite web |title=Sajjan Bhajanka, Chairman, Century Plyboards (I) Ltd. |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/article/research-leader-speak/sajjan-bhajanka-chairman-century-plyboards-i-ltd-38713906_1.html |access-date=14 October 2015 |publisher=India Infoline}}</ref><ref name=":0">{{cite web |title=Century Plyboards (India) Limited |url=http://www.fippi.org/century.htm |access-date=14 October 2015 |publisher=FIPPI}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{cite web |date=17 October 2017 |title=Sanjay Agarwal, MD, Century Plyboards (I) Ltd. |url=http://www.moneycontrol.com/elite/profile/sanjay-agarwal_3742.html |access-date=17 October 2017 |publisher=Money Control}}</ref> Sajjan Bhajanka has been serving as its chairman since 31 October 2011.<ref name="India Infoline" /><ref name=":0" /> He serves as the Chairman of Star Ferro and Cement Limited, Century Plyboards Ltd. and Shyam Century Ferrous Limited.<ref>{{cite web |title=Sajjan Bhajanka, Star Cement Ltd: Profile and Biography |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/research/stocks/people/person.asp?personId=43243972&privcapId=20334312 |access-date=16 July 2016 |publisher=Bloomberg |url-access=subscription |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210417182400/https://www.bloomberg.com/profile/person/15053909 |archive-date= 17 Apr 2021 }}</ref> In 2013, the company launched its furniture stores under the sub-brand 'Nesta'.<ref name="The Hindu">{{cite news |author=Dutta, Indrani |date=16 August 2015 |title=Century Plyboard plans e-commerce platform for furniture sales |work=The Hindu |agency=The Hindu |url=http://www.thehindu.com/business/Industry/century-plyboard-plans-ecommerce-platform-for-furniture-sales/article7544549.ece |access-date=9 October 2015}}</ref> In the same year, the company launched its subsidiary company Century Infotech. In 2015, Century Ply (Singapore) Pte. Ltd., a subsidiary of Century Plyboards (India) Ltd in Singapore incorporated Century Ply Laos Co. Ltd. in [[Laos]].<ref>{{cite web |date=17 October 2015 |title=Century Plyboards (India) Ltd forms subsidiary in Laos |url=http://www.equitybulls.com/admin/news2006/news_det.asp?id=171473 |access-date=23 October 2015 |publisher=Equity Bulls}}</ref> The company began its manufacturing facilities near [[Kolkata]], [[Karnal]], [[Guwahati]], [[Hoshiarpur]], [[Kandla]] and [[Chennai]] and opened stores in many parts of India.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2018-09-17 |title=Century Plyboards to harness solar power |language=en-IN |work=The Hindu |url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/Industry/century-plyboards-to-harness-solar-power/article24969793.ece |access-date=2022-11-09 |issn=0971-751X}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |last=Dutta |first=Indrani |date=2018-01-03 |title=Century Ply hopeful of early profit from Hoshiarpur unit |language=en-IN |work=The Hindu |url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/century-ply-hopeful-of-early-profit-from-hoshiarpur-unit/article22360531.ece |access-date=2022-11-09 |issn=0971-751X}}</ref> It became the first company to receive [[ISO 9000|ISO 9002]] certification for veneer and plywood.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |last=Sriram |first=Malathy |date=2020-12-19 |title=Century Plywood: Building a culture of innovation over decades |url=https://bloncampus.thehindubusinessline.com/columns/brand-basics/century-plywood-building-a-culture-of-innovation-over-decades/article33371181.ece |access-date=2022-11-09 |website=BLoC |language=en}}</ref> Its subsidiary Century Infra was incorporated on 30 December 2021.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Kumar |first=Shivendra |date=2022-07-20 |title=Q1 Results FY23: Havells India, Century Plyboards, Newgen Software, Tata Communications declare June quarter results - highlights |url=https://www.zeebiz.com/companies/news-q1-results-fy23-havells-india-century-plyboards-newgen-software-tata-communications-declare-june-quarter-results-highlights-190478 |access-date=2022-11-09 |website=Zee Business}}</ref>

===EV Delivery Vans===
Century Plyboards launched a pilot project of [[Electric vehicle|EV]] delivery vans in July 2022. The vans are claimed to reduce carbon emissions by 17-30%.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-07-28 |title=Century Plyboards launches EV delivery vans as a part of a pilot project |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/century-plyboards-launches-ev-delivery-vans-as-a-part-of-a-pilot-project-c/article65693901.ece |access-date=2022-11-09 |website=The Hindu Business Line |language=en}}</ref>

==Board of directors==
Sanjay Agarwal is the Promoter and MD of Century Ply Boards (India) Ltd.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1" /> He is also the Promoter and Director of Star Cement and a key member of the executive committee of [[Indian Chamber of Commerce]], Member of [[Confederation of Indian Industry]] (East) and Member of [[Young Presidents' Organization|Young Presidents Organization]] GOLD (Kolkata). Sunil Mitra, Debanjan Mandal, and Vijay Chhibber serve as Directors while Nikita Bansal and Keshav Bhajanka serve as Executive Directors of the company. In addition, the company has 11 other board members.<ref>{{Cite news |title=Century Plyboards (India) Ltd. |work=Business Standard India |url=https://www.business-standard.com/company/century-plyboard-15783/info |access-date=2022-11-09}}</ref>

==Awards==
CenturyPly is the first [[ISO 9000|ISO 9002]] company in India for Veneer and Plywood. In 2012, the company won Alumni Achievement Awards; Cool Tool Award 2012 Winner, and Network Marketing Awards.<ref name=":2" /> In 2022, Century Plyboards (India) Ltd won E4m Pride of India Brands Honors.<ref>{{Cite web |title=First edition of e4m Pride of India Brands honours 175 Indian brands  |url=https://www.exchange4media.com/marketing-news/first-edition-of-e4m-pride-of-india-honours-175-indian-brands-119826.html |date= 21 Apr 2022 |access-date=2022-11-09 |website=exchange4media |language=en}}</ref>

==CSR activities==
In November 2019, Century Ply donated INR 2 lakh to Tata Medical Center for the treatment of underprivileged patients of [[breast cancer]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=CenturyPly hands out INR 2 lakh to Tata Medical Centre towards treatment and care of under privileged patients of breast cancer |url=http://www.uniindia.com/~/centuryply-hands-out-inr-2-lakh-to-tata-medical-centre-towards-treatment-and-care-of-under-privileged-patients-of-breast-cancer/States/news/1788635.html |website=United News of India |date=13 Nov 2019 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221110060548/http://www.uniindia.com/~/centuryply-hands-out-inr-2-lakh-to-tata-medical-centre-towards-treatment-and-care-of-under-privileged-patients-of-breast-cancer/States/news/1788635.html |archive-date= 10 Nov 2022 }}</ref>

In July 2021, the company pledged to plant 10,000 trees across [[West Bengal]] and [[Haryana]] as part of [[Van Mahotsav]].<ref>{{Cite web |last= |first= |date=2021-07-06 |title=CSR: CenturyPly pledges to plant 10,000 trees on Van Mahotsav 2021 |url=https://indiacsr.in/csr-centuryply-pledges-to-plant-10000-trees-on-van-mahotsav-2021/ |access-date=2022-11-09 |website=India CSR |language=en-US |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221110060701/https://indiacsr.in/csr-centuryply-pledges-to-plant-10000-trees-on-van-mahotsav-2021/ |archive-date= 10 Nov 2022 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=CenturyPly pledges to plant 10,000 trees on Van Mahotsav 2021 |url=http://www.uniindia.com/centuryply-pledges-to-plant-10-000-trees-on-van-mahotsav-2021/east/news/2441422.html |website=United News Of India |date=6 Jul 2021 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230324070248/http://www.uniindia.com/centuryply-pledges-to-plant-10-000-trees-on-van-mahotsav-2021/east/news/2441422.html |archive-date= 24 Mar 2023 }}</ref>
